qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Government outsourcing operations face sovereign monopsony buyers and competitive procurement tenders. Regular contract re-bidding and capped margins erode returns, keeping multi-year GAAP ROIC below the 12% hurdle (~9.5-10.2%) with operating margins constrained to ~5-6% and minimal pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). International public services outsourcing contractor facing sovereign monopsony buyers, periodic competitive re-tenders, razor-thin operating margins (~5.1-5.7%), and sub-hurdle multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (~9.5-10.2%) lacking structural pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Serco's underlying operating margin hovers between 5.1% and 5.7% (FY2023-2025). 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~9.5-10.2%, persistently below the 12% quality threshold. B2G contracts across defense, justice, and citizen services are subject to competitive rebidding, political scrutiny, and capped margin structures that prevent excess economic returns.
